THH-shaped Pt NCs are prepared at high yields by electrochemical treatment of glassy carbon-supported Pt NCs.

(a) the shape of Pt NCs can be controlled by an electrochemical process; (b) THH Pt NCs with high-index facets can be prepared at high yield; and (c) THH NCs have much higher electro-oxidation activity than the usual Pt NCs with low-index surfaces.
